releases.description:
## Owen Exporter 0.1.17

- Added distinct Lucide icons and stable semantic section identifiers to all five settings groups.
- Aligned Owen Exporter settings with the grouped Owen Mermaid and Owen Graphite settings layout.

Validation:
- npm run build
- 11 tests passed
- TypeScript check passed

releases.author: towishy
releases.description: Added complete English and Korean interface localization. Owen Exporter now follows Obsidian locale automatically, maps Korean locales to Korean and all others to English, and supports explicit language overrides under Interface > Language. Validation: 11 tests passed and the production TypeScript build passed.
